description: Aléa sismique par commune en région Bourgogne-Franche-Comté (décret du 22/10/10) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Aléa sismique par commune en BFC. Les zones sont définies par décret n° 2010-1255 du 22 octobre 2010 portant délimitation des zones de sismicité du territoire français. Les zonages concernent 5 niveaux de sismicité: 1 - très faible, 2 - faible, 3 - modérée, 4 - moyenne, 5 - forte. Coverage: DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Its keywords include zones-risque-naturel, dreal-bfc, donnes-ouvertes, bourgogne-franche-comt, sisme. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
